items.text: Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to ankle injury mid-game vs Bucs.
items.why: Ankle injury in first half after 2/32.
items.implication: Monitor severity; Addison/Hockenson targets spike short-term.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs with knee injury; coach Jeff Hafley says does not sound optimistic.
items.why: Non-contact knee on early run; walked off gingerly.
items.implication: Major ROS concern; handcuff/backup elevation critical.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps to remaining RBs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout looked good; likely limited usage on hamstring.
items.why: Pregame workout positive; team decision after not counting on him.
items.implication: Startable but pitch count risk; reverse Bateman/Andrews upside.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Achane (knee), Jefferson (ankle), Hall (quad), Etienne (hamstring), Evans (rib), Mayfield (thumb), Coker (quad), Andrews (hand), Spears (ankle), Bech (forearm).
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated right thumb; MRI tomorrow, likely to miss time.
items.implication: Backup QB and skill player volume shifts.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF at Broncos (groin/hip impacting explosiveness; possible next week).
49ers WR Mike Evans ruled out with rib injury after being carted off; was expected to play on prior hip issue.
items.why: Rib strain after hard hit; carted.
items.implication: Painful; full eval Monday; short-term WR depth impact.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury vs Lions.
items.why: Thigh injury late; discomfort after tackle.
items.implication: Backup RB opportunity; check next practice.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make 2026 season debut vs Saints.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 usage likely; Mayer downgrade.

items.text: Jets WR AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger); Garrett Wilson clear WR1, Isaiah Williams next, TE Kenyon Sadiq projected slot/wide snaps.
items.why: Mitchell GTD to inactive per source; prior high targets.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets spike; Sadiq versatile alignment.

items.text: Raiders WR Jack Bech broken forearm, headed to IR but return later this season.
items.why: Broken forearm ruled out of game.

items.text: If Zay Flowers active for Ravens, start him over Bateman despite risk.
items.implication: Prefer Flowers in lineups if cleared.
items.conflict: Levitan had out in early projs.

items.text: Zay Flowers out in ETR projections initially (hamstring); late swap for Bateman/Andrews DFS; Moore limited/in, Mitchell out.
items.why: No counting on him; update if changes.
items.implication: DFS pivot to secondary options pre-confirmation.
items.conflict: Later ACTIVE; Berry start if active.

items.text: AM summary: Flowers GTD (not counting), Spears hopeful; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman.
items.implication: Most key players lean in; Flowers volatile.
